# Community Outreach

Community outreach is critical to the Hamilton County Clerk of Courts and its mission to increase access to justice. The Clerk’s outreach efforts aim to increase public awareness and access to information and services provided by the Clerk of Courts.

The Clerk of Courts partners with local law firms, community agencies, and government institutions to address the needs of constituents as they navigate through the court system and to support the interests of individuals seeking to learn more about the justice system. Various events hosted by the Clerk’s Office and/or partner organizations seek to promote conversations with the community around services offered and receive meaningful feedback from customers.

### Giving Back

The Clerk of Courts office is passionate about contributing to our community. We’re proud to support organizations like the Freestore Foodbank. The Clerk of Courts staff recently spent a morning packing food boxes for students and seniors. We look forward to continuing to volunteer to organizations making a difference in our community.

### Connect with Us

The Clerk’s Office utilizes social media to better connect with our customers. Whether we’re promoting a new service that adds convenience or simply announcing that one of our offices in closed for a Holiday, social media tools like Facebook and Twitter help us communicate with the community. Make sure to follow us on Twitter and Facebook to stay up to date with the Clerk of Courts Office!

- [![](https://www.courtclerk.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/facebook.png)](https://www.facebook.com/HamiltonCountyClerkofCourts/)
- [![](https://www.courtclerk.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/twitter.png)](https://twitter.com/HamCoClerk)

[Contact Us](https://www.courtclerk.org/contact-us/)

### Request A Speaker

If you would like to hear more about what our dedicated staff of deputy clerks do every day, we would love to share our story at your next community gathering or event.

[Request A Speaker](mailto:info@cms.hamilton-co.org)
